title: Anglo-Japanese Treaty of Commerce and Navigation
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Anglo-Japanese Treaty of Commerce and Navigation", at revision 1367661886, opens: "The Anglo-Japanese Treaty of Commerce and Navigation  signed by Britain and Japan, on 16 July 1894, was a breakthrough agreement; it heralded the end of the unequal treaties and the system of extraterritoriality in Japan. The treaty came into force on 17 July 1899 and lasted until 26 July 1941, less than five months before attack on Pearl Harbor." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2915092, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1894 treaty between the United Kingdom and Japan". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
